_comment: Corrections to harvested rows where Wikidata itself is wrong. Applied by scripts/dedupe-places.mjs on every run (after the harvest), so the nightly harvest cannot put the mistake back. A value of null removes that field. Each fix: the fields to set (name, lat, lon, startYear, endYear, placeNote, dateNote), why, and the source checked. A moved pin is also listed in wikidata-coord-exceptions.json so the 25 km lint knows it is deliberate.

q603549.placeNote: Wikidata places this battle in southern Iraq (31.58, 44.50), about 450 km from Nahavand. It was fought at Nahavand, near Hamadan in Iran; the pin is on the town.

q47465940.name: Operation Olive Branch (Afrin)
q47465940.why: Wrong year: the Turkish operation in Afrin ran 20 January – 24 March 2018

q111383245.why: Wrong year: the battle ran 10 October 2023 – 17 February 2024

q1355254.placeNote: Wikidata places this battle in Cilicia (37.89, 36.00), about 740 km from Poimanenon. It was fought near Poimanenon, south of the Sea of Marmara (near modern Manyas); the pin uses Pleiades' precise position for the town.

q11812902.why: Wrong year (2020): Serengeti National Park was established in 1951

q107370.dateNote: Founded as Iceland's first national park in 1930, on the 1,000th anniversary of the Althing, the parliament that met here from 930. A World Heritage Site since 2004.
q107370.why: Wrong year (2004 is its World Heritage listing): the national park dates from 1930

q214944.dateNote: Built from about 9500 BCE, in the Pre-Pottery Neolithic. Wikidata gives only the millennium.
q214944.why: Wikidata's millennium-precision date read as -9999; matches the curated entry (c. 9500 BCE)

q39671.dateNote: Built in stages: the first ditch and bank c. 3000 BCE, the great sarsen circle c. 2500 BCE, work continuing until about 1600 BCE.
q39671.why: Wikidata date (-1848) is neither the start nor the main building phase

q134140.dateNote: Carved for Ramesses II from about 1264 BCE, finished about 1244 BCE. Moved 65 m uphill in 1964–68 to escape Lake Nasser.
q134140.why: Wrong year (-1274 is the Battle of Kadesh it celebrates): begun c. 1264 BCE

q752091.dateNote: Built about 1250 under King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty.

q5684.why: End year 1599 CE is meaningless (no such event); Babylon declined after the Seleucid era and the ruin still stands. Removed.

q922200.placeNote: Wikidata gives a rounded point (39, -4) about 100 km away. The battle was fought below the castle of Montiel, in La Mancha, where Peter of Castile was besieged and then killed.
q922200.why: Rounded Wikidata pin ~100 km from Montiel

pl79612.dateNote: Built about 3200 BCE — older than Stonehenge's stone circle and the Giza pyramids. Its passage is lit by the rising sun around the winter solstice.
pl79612.why: Pleiades period date (-4000) is earlier than the monument; built c. 3200 BCE

cur-lalibela.why: Duplicate pin: q642979 (the same churches) was folded in; the Captain chose the pin closest to Wikidata (13 Oct 2026)

q3636565.placeNote: Wikidata gives a rounded point (45, 8) in Piedmont, about 160 km away. The river battle was fought on the Po near Cremona, where the Milanese galleys beat the Venetian fleet in June 1431.
q3636565.why: Rounded Wikidata pin ~160 km from Cremona

q771423.placeNote: Wikidata gives a rounded point (42, 24) about 64 km away. The battle was fought in and around Philippopolis, today Plovdiv.

q239.dateNote: Brussels is traditionally said to have been founded in 979, when Charles of Lower Lorraine built a fort on an island in the Senne. Wikidata's earliest record of the place is 966. The exact year is not certain.
q239.why: Wrong year (1795): Brussels dates from the 10th century, not the French annexation

q1024647.dateNote: Founded in the 15th century; the exact year is not known.
q1024647.why: Century typed as a year: Wikidata has '15' for the 15th century, and the harvest showed it as AD 15

q1023721.dateNote: Founded in the 17th century; the exact year is not known.
q1023721.why: Century typed as a year: Wikidata has '17' for the 17th century, and the harvest showed it as AD 17

q587085.dateNote: Founded in the 18th century; the exact year is not known.
q587085.why: Century typed as a year: Wikidata has '18' for the 18th century, and the harvest showed it as AD 18

cur-aztec-empire.why: Pin rounded to 0.1 degree, about 5 km south-east of Tenochtitlan; moved to Wikidata's point for the empire, at its capital (central Mexico City)

cur-trip-jerusalem.dateNote: The inn claims to date from 1189, but no record survives to prove it. Most of the present building dates from about 1650 (the date Wikidata gives); the caves behind it are older.
cur-trip-jerusalem.why: Uncertain date: the 1189 claim is the inn's own tradition; Wikidata gives 1650

cur-mali-empire.placeNote: Pinned near Bamako, in the empire's heartland on the upper Niger. Where its capital stood (Niani, Dakajalan or elsewhere) is still debated, so this is not the site of a known city.
cur-mali-empire.why: Uncertain place: an empire has no single point and its capital's site is disputed; Wikidata gives no coordinates

q350.dateNote: A Roman settlement stood here from the 1st century AD. Wikidata gives only the century, so the year shown is approximate.
q350.why: Uncertain date: Wikidata P571 is century-precision ('1st century'), shown as AD 1

cur-sulawesi-art.dateNote: The paintings are dated by the mineral crust that grew over them, which gives only a minimum age: the hunting scene at Leang Bulu' Sipong 4 is at least 44,000 years old, the pig at Leang Tedongnge at least 45,500, and a 2024 study puts a scene at Leang Karampuang at 51,200 years.
cur-sulawesi-art.why: Uncertain date: minimum ages only, and different caves give different ages

cur-chichen-itza.dateNote: Sources differ on when the city began: Wikidata gives 455, while most accounts put its rise around 600 and its height between about 900 and 1100.
cur-chichen-itza.why: Uncertain date: Wikidata P571 is 455, the panel shows c. 600

cur-ife.dateNote: The date shown is the start of Ife's classical age, known for its bronze and terracotta heads. People lived here much earlier (Wikidata says between 1000 and 500 BC), but there is no agreed founding date.
cur-ife.why: Uncertain date: no agreed founding year; Wikidata gives a range in its description only
